description: This file defines API routes for a note-taking backend application using FastAPI. It includes user authentication (register/login) and CRUD operations for notes, with features like search filtering and user-specific access control.

methods.name: register_user(user_data: UserCreate, db: Session = Depends(get_db))
methods.description: Registers a new user and returns a JWT token.

methods.name: login_user(login: UserLogin, db: Session = Depends(get_db))
methods.description: Authenticates a user and provides a JWT token.

methods.name: create_note( note: NoteCreate, db: Session = Depends(get_db), user_email: str = Depends(get_current_user_email), )
methods.description: Creates a new note for the authenticated user.

methods.name: list_notes( db: Session = Depends(get_db), user_email: str = Depends(get_current_user_email), search: str = Query("", description="Optional search by keyword"), )
methods.description: Lists all notes for the current user, optionally filtered by a search term.

methods.name: get_note( note_id: int, db: Session = Depends(get_db), user_email: str = Depends(get_current_user_email), )
methods.description: Retrieves a specific note by ID for the current user.

methods.name: update_note( note_id: int, note_update: NoteUpdate, db: Session = Depends(get_db), user_email: str = Depends(get_current_user_email), )
methods.description: Updates the title or content of a specific note.

methods.name: delete_note( note_id: int, db: Session = Depends(get_db), user_email: str = Depends(get_current_user_email), )
methods.description: Deletes a specific note belonging to the current user.

ctags.name: list_notes

ctags.signature: ( note_id: int, note_update: NoteUpdate, db: Session = Depends(get_db), user_email: str = Depends(get_current_user_email), )
